learning_outcomes.text: To give students practical skills and knowledge of the main machining processes, the machines and tools that are applied in them as well as various machining and assembling operations.

syllabus_topics: Organization, preparation and control of various machine tools, cutting tools, equipment and the positioning of the parts or cutting tools on machines.
Independent work on a Milling machine
Independent work on a Drilling machine
Laying out parts and carrying out basic bench operations in the bench department
Making a check part following a drawing
assessment_rules: Students' knowledge is assessed through discussions as well as during the practical and laboratory exercises. The final grade is the result of a colloquium, which is an oral exam.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
